svg.title: Stage 00 Formal Statement & Comparator Audit Architecture
svg.desc: Three-column architecture diagram of Stage 00 formal contracts, proof entry point, and independent comparator and kernel audit specifications pinned at upstream commit 41c2716658c4. Column 1 shows active statement and challenge contracts: src/Statements.lean (public import Mathlib; 4 Prop definitions: RiemannZetaZerosOnLine, DirichletLNonvanishingRightOfHalf, DirichletLZerosOnLine, PrimitiveDirichletLZerosOnLine) with a direct import Statements arrow down to root Challenge.lean (5 sorry target specifications at lines 8, 11, 14, 17, 20), plus a muted dashed archived card for comparator/FormalConjecturesStatement.lean and FormalConjecturesChallenge.lean marked Archived on alpoge (c900e67c2), pending re-integration on condensed main. Column 2 shows src/Main.lean (public import New.Main, discharging all 5 target theorems via New.grh: riemannHypothesis, riemannZeta_eq_zero_re, LFunction_ne_zero_of_half_lt_re, LFunction_eq_zero_re, LFunction_eq_zero_re_of_isPrimitive), plus a muted dashed archived card for comparator/FormalConjecturesBridge.lean and FormalConjecturesSolution.lean marked Archived on alpoge (c900e67c2), pending re-integration on condensed main. Column 3 shows root comparator.json (comparing Challenge against Main across 5 theorems, permitted axioms propext, Quot.sound, Classical.choice, enable_nanoda: true) and an amber dashed Local Audit Snapshot box pinned at 41c2716658c4 reporting build_status unverified-locally, 0 forbidden tokens in solution, 5 expected challenge sorrys, and entry scope 3 files.
